headline: Rick surges from 1051st to 51st on ARC-AGI-2

sections.text: Rick gained 13.33 to reach 43.75 on the ARC-AGI-2 public board, moving from 1051st to 51st in the past day.
It is the largest single-day gain on that board in this update, and the team now sits well inside the top 100 with the gold line held at 66.53 for the 16th gold place.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
